# TSN Media

> > TSN Media is a comprehensive resource for AI, LLM, and tech infrastructure guides covering self-hosting, quantization, vector databases, and emerging technologies.

TSN Media provides in-depth technical documentation and analysis on AI/ML infrastructure, local LLM deployment, and emerging tech trends. The site serves both developers and tech enthusiasts with practical guides, industry analysis, and curated resources.

## Key Topics

- Self-Hosting LLMs
- DeepSeek-R1
- Llama 3 / Llama 3.2
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Quantization (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ)
- Vector Databases & RAG
- Vision LLMs (LLaVA)
- Prompt Engineering
- Edge AI
- AI Infrastructure
- Raspberry Pi Deployment
- Local AI
- Tech Regulation (EU AI Act)
- GitHub Resources

## LLM Self-Hosting & Deployment

- [Self-Hosting LLMs in 2026: Complete Setup Guide | DeepSeek-R1 & Llama 3](https://tsnmedia.org/self-hosting-llms-in-2026-the-complete-setup-guide-deepseek-r1-llama-3-and-beyond): Complete setup guide for deploying DeepSeek-R1 and Llama 3 locally
- [Self-Hosting Small LLMs: Raspberry Pi to MacBook Pro | 2026 Guide](https://tsnmedia.org/self-hosting-small-llms-from-raspberry-pi-to-macbook-pro-2026-edition): Guide to running Phi-3, Llama 3.2 on minimal hardware devices
- [Prompt Engineering for Self-Hosted LLMs: Small Model Guide | 2026](https://tsnmedia.org/prompt-engineering-for-self-hosted-llms-getting-the-most-from-small-models): Prompt engineering techniques for 3B-8B self-hosted language models
- [Vision LLMs Locally: LLaVA, BakLLaVA Guide | 2026](https://tsnmedia.org/running-vision-llms-locally-llava-bakllava-beyond-2026-guide): Setup guide for running LLaVA and BakLLaVA vision models locally

## AI Infrastructure & Advanced Techniques

- [Quantization Deep Dive: GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ, EXL2 | 2026 Guide](https://tsnmedia.org/quantization-deep-dive-gguf-awq-gptq-exl2-compared-2026-guide): Technical comparison of LLM quantization formats and use cases
- [Vector Databases for RAG: Chroma to Production | 2026 Guide](https://tsnmedia.org/vector-databases-for-rag-from-chroma-to-production-2026-guide): Guide to vector databases for RAG with Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate
- [MCP Explained: The USB-C for AI Tools | Anthropic Protocol Guide](https://tsnmedia.org/mcp-explained-the-usb-c-for-ai-tools-model-context-protocol-guide): Guide to Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool integration
- [20 Essential GitHub Repositories Every AI Engineer Needs in 2026](https://tsnmedia.org/20-essential-github-repositories-every-ai-engineer-needs-in-2026): Curated list of 20 essential GitHub repos for AI engineers in 2026

## AI & Tech Industry Analysis

- [Bezos's $100B AI Manufacturing Bet: The Takeover Explained | 2026](https://tsnmedia.org/bezoss-00-billion-bet-the-ai-manufacturing-takeover-explained): Analysis of Jeff Bezos's $100B AI manufacturing investment strategy
- [Google's Antigravity Launch: The End of Coding As We Know It | TSN](https://tsnmedia.org/google-antigravity-launch-end-of-coding): Analysis of Google's Antigravity AI agent for no-code development
- [AI Regulation 2026: EU MiCA, AI Act, US Rules | TSN Media](https://tsnmedia.org/the-regulatory-wave-how-eu-mica-and-the-ai-act-are-reshaping-tech): Analysis of EU MiCA and AI Act regulatory impacts on tech industry
- [Why X's New Algorithm Benefits Creators | Merit-Based | TSN Media](https://tsnmedia.org/why-xs-new-algorithm-is-a-game-changer-for-content-creators-3): Article on X's Grok-powered algorithm changes for content creators
